title: Workshop tree
description: The workshop-tree.json file of a workshop published as a GitHub gist. A gist holds no directories, so each file of the workshop is stored under a flat name, and this file maps every workshop-relative path to the gist file that holds it. A download of the gist puts each file back at its path and leaves out any gist file not listed. Paths must stay inside the workshop directory and outside its _workshop state directory; the extension also refuses two entries for one path compared without case, a path that is also the directory of another, and two entries reading one gist file.

files.description: Every file of the workshop, workshop.yaml included.

name.description: The gist file holding the content.

encoding.description: How the gist file encodes the content, for a file that is not text: base64, which may be wrapped over several lines.

empty.description: An empty file, which a gist cannot hold, so it has no gist file and is created empty.

path.description: Workshop-relative POSIX path the file is restored to.
